title: Drag and drop sections into place
text: Build pages from theme sections. Each section is a template annotation in your markdown, so what you arrange visually is saved as plain content you can read and version.
ticks: Theme sections via template annotations (HTML comments in markdown)

title: A block editor that renders your real sections
text: The block editor renders live Vue section components in the canvas and gives every block a schema-driven settings panel. Existing markdown files load into blocks and save back to the same format.
ticks: Type `/` to open the block palette, filter with `/hero`, `/head` or `/image`
Text, Heading, Section, Layout, Image, Quote, Divider, List and Carousel blocks
Block controls for drag handle, duplicate, delete and settings
Per-line list indentation with Tab and Shift+Tab

title: Your content stays in markdown
text: Content lives under `sites/<slug>/content/*.md`. Greemo extends markdown with special comment tags for template parsing, so sections, data and components sit alongside ordinary text.
source: docs/GETTING_STARTED.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Comment Tag System), apps/web Settings (Live preview)

title: Ask for changes in plain English
text: The AI assistant lets you work with a site in natural language. It understands the current page and site context, suggests changes for review and reflects applied changes immediately in preview.
ticks: Context-Aware: understands current page and site context
Built-in prompts such as "Rewrite this page", "Add a hero section" and "Shorten the copy"

title: Vue, React or Svelte: pick your framework
text: Templates are framework-agnostic HTML files with placeholders, and the framework is a project setting. Choose Vue.js, React or Svelte, with Tailwind 4 styling integration.
ticks: Vue.js: component-based architecture, reactive data binding, Single File Components
React: JSX support, hooks and functional components
Install a website theme and choose its header and footer

title: Every site in one workspace
text: Choose the folder where sites will live and Greemo manages each site from a local `sites/<slug>/` workspace. Switch between sites from the editor header.
ticks: New Project and Scan for Projects from the dashboard

title: Reusable sections for every theme
text: A curated collection of section components that can be added to any Greemo theme, with local overrides per site. Browse default and custom blocks, or drop in a JSON file or a folder.
ticks: Hero, Features, Text Block, Column grid and Stack defaults
Collected from the most complete sites and organised for easy reuse
